mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_publication_requests (token_hash, user_id, agent_id, memory_id, content_hash, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{memoryId}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, token_hash, user_id, agent_id, memory_id, content_hash, status, expires_at FROM memory_publication_requests WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_publication_requests SET status = #{status}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
